queries.query: large language model AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps OR "network management" OR "intent to configuration" OR "intent-to-config") (GPT OR LLaMA OR PaLM OR Claude OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Locate primary work using LLMs to generate network configurations or translate operator intent into device configs; establishes direct precedent and methods.

queries.query: ("configuration repair" OR "configuration fix" OR "misconfiguration repair" OR "config repair") (LLM OR "large language model" OR GPT OR "transformer") NetOps
queries.rationale: Find studies on LLM-assisted automated detection and repair of network misconfigurations (generate–validate–repair workflows).

queries.query: (Batfish OR "Header Space Analysis" OR HSA OR "network verification") (formal verification OR symbolic verification OR reachability OR invariants) (network configuration)
queries.rationale: Survey deterministic/network-verification tools and formalisms used as validators or oracles for checking generated configs; identify canonical validators to pair with LLMs.

queries.query: "generate-validate-repair" OR "generate validate repair" OR "LLM + verifier" "self-correction" (LLM OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Capture architectural patterns combining LLM generation with external validators and automated repair loops; important for mitigation strategies.

queries.query: ("hallucination" OR "fabrication" OR "incorrect synthesis") (LLM OR "large language model") (code OR configuration OR "network config")
queries.rationale: Collect literature on LLM error modes relevant to producing incorrect executable artifacts (here: device configs) to characterise failure phenomena.

queries.query: ("tool use" OR "tool-augmented" OR ReAct OR Toolformer OR "plan-and-execute" OR "LLM agent") (API OR "network tool" OR "cli" OR "netconf")
queries.rationale: Identify agentic/tool-augmented LLM architectures and their applicability to NetOps (e.g., calling simulators, validators, or device APIs).

queries.query: (AIOps OR "automated remediation" OR "autonomous remediation" OR "self-healing network") (network OR NetOps) (LLM OR model OR agent)
queries.rationale: Find broader AIOps literature on autonomous remediation and incident response relevant to agentic NetOps workflows and operational safeguards.

queries.query: (benchmark OR dataset OR evaluation) (NetOps OR "network configuration" OR AIOps OR "networking benchmark" OR "NetEval" OR "OpsEval" OR "6G-Bench" OR "TSNBench" OR "OWL")
queries.rationale: Locate existing benchmarks, datasets, and task suites used to evaluate models/systems in networking and AIOps to assess benchmark validity and gaps.

queries.query: (metric OR metrics OR "evaluation criteria") ("operational correctness" OR safety OR robustness OR "reachability" OR "policy compliance" OR "intent satisfaction") network
queries.rationale: Collect candidate operational metrics and evaluation methodologies appropriate for judging LLM-generated NetOps artifacts beyond NLP-centric measures.

queries.query: (Mininet OR ns-3 OR GNS3 OR "EVE-NG" OR "network emulator" OR simulator OR "virtual lab") ("experiment" OR benchmark OR evaluation) network
queries.rationale: Identify realistic emulation/simulation environments and toolchains commonly used to execute and validate network configs produced by automated agents.

queries.query: ("adversarial" OR "red team" OR "safety testing" OR "prompt injection" OR "attack") (LLM OR "language model") (network OR NetOps OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Discover adversarial testing methods and red-team strategies specific to operational deployment of LLM agents in NetOps; important for threat modelling and mitigations.

queries.query: ("human-in-the-loop" OR "operator oversight" OR "verification by human" OR "trust" OR "explainability") (NetOps OR network) (LLM OR agent)
queries.rationale: Survey human–AI interaction literature for NetOps to understand practical mitigation (approval gates, explainable outputs, handoff design).

queries.query: (survey OR review) ("LLM for network" OR "LLM for NetOps" OR "AIOps survey" OR "network automation survey" OR "AI for network management")
queries.rationale: Locate systematic reviews and surveys to summarise the state-of-the-art and identify consensus gaps and open problems.

queries.query: (case study OR field study OR "operational deployment") (LLM OR agent OR AIOps) (network OR NetOps OR "network operations")
queries.rationale: Find real-world or longitudinal case studies that reveal practical failure modes, mitigation effectiveness, and deployment constraints.
source_preferences: industry whitepapers (Cisco, Juniper, Google Cloud, AWS)

queries.query: ("reproducibility" OR "benchmark validity" OR "evaluation bias") (LLM OR language model) (networking OR AIOps OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Collect literature critiquing benchmark design and validity to guide evaluation choices and avoid misleading comparisons.

inclusion_criteria: Primary research (papers, arXiv preprints, and tool documentation) that apply LLMs or agentic language models to network configuration, NetOps, or AIOps tasks.
Work proposing, using, or evaluating validators/verifiers for network configurations (e.g., Batfish, Header Space Analysis), including older classical literature on network verification.
Architectural or methodological papers on generate–validate–repair, tool-augmented LLM agents (ReAct, Toolformer, Reflexion), and agent orchestration applicable to NetOps.
Benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation suites for NetOps, AIOps, or LLMs performing operational tasks; reproducible datasets or public code preferred.
Papers on LLM failure modes (hallucinations, incorrect code/config synthesis), adversarial testing, red-teaming, and safety or robustness testing relevant to operational workflows.
Human–AI interaction studies for operational settings (human-in-the-loop, approval workflows, trust, explainability) when applied to network operations.
Simulation or emulation environments (Mininet, ns-3, GNS3, EVE-NG) used to execute or validate network configurations generated by automated systems.
Surveys and systematic reviews summarizing AIOps/NetOps automation or LLM applications in operational domains.
exclusion_criteria: Papers purely about generic NLP tasks with no networking or operational artifact (configuration/commands/workflows) application.
ML-theory-only papers that lack an explicit mapping to NetOps tasks or validation pathways.
Non-reproducible blog posts, unaffiliated marketing materials, or social-media claims without primary references (unless they point to primary artifacts).
Works in languages other than English unless they include English abstracts and accessible primary artifacts.
Proprietary closed-source datasets or vendor-internal reports that lack sufficient methodological detail for verification (note: vendor whitepapers with reproducible methods may be included).
date_rationale: Include LLM-, agent-, and AIOps-specific literature primarily from 2018–2026 to capture the rapid emergence of foundation models and agentic tool-use patterns, while also including earlier foundational work on network verification and formal methods (pre-2018) as necessary to identify canonical validators (e.g., Header Space Analysis, Batfish) and long-standing evaluation constructs.
